class Cache{constructor(){this.cache=new Map();}get(key){const entry=this.cache.get(key);if(!entry)return null;const now=Date.now();if(now-entry.timestamp>entry.ttl){this.cache.delete(key);return null;}return entry.data;}set(key,data){let ttl=arguments.length>2&&arguments[2]!==undefined?arguments[2]:60000;this.cache.set(key,{data,timestamp:Date.now(),ttl});}invalidate(key){this.cache.delete(key);}invalidatePrefix(prefix){for(const key of this.cache.keys()){if(key.startsWith(prefix)){this.cache.delete(key);}}}clear(){this.cache.clear();}}export const cache=new Cache();
